title: NVS Class 11 Admissions Online Form 2027 Apply Online
intro:

Tag: 10th Pass Admission Form
applicationFee: There is no Application Fee for all categories
fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), has invited online applications for the Navodaya Vidyalaya JNV Selection Test for Class XI (2027- 28) on the official website of the NVS recently. Online registration process for NVS Class 11th Admission 2027 has started from 02 September 2026. The last date to apply for the NVS Class 11th Admission 2027 is 30 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NVS Class 11th Admission Form 2027 which has given below. below.

Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS)

NVS Class 11th Admissions Online Form 2027

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Last Date : 30 September 2026 
  • Exam Date : 10 April 2027
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • There is no Application Fee for all categories

[adinserter block=”3″]

NVS Class 11 Admissions Online Form 2027 : Age Limit

  • Candidates must not have been born before 01-June-2010 and after 31-July-2012.
  • Use Tool –

NVS Class 11 Admissions 2027: Examination Details

  • Exam Name : Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test (JNVST) – 2027
  • Class of Admission : Class-XI (11th) 
  • Total School : 653

NVS Class 11 Admissions 2027 : Qualification 

  • Candidates who are bonafide residents and must have passed the Class 10th Examination in one of the Govt./Govt. recognized schools of the district where the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya is functioning and where admission is sought.
  • Candidate must be a Resident of the District where the Navodaya School is Open.
  • For More Details regarding Eligibility Criteria, Candidates must read the official notification.

NVS Class 11 Admissions Online Form 2027 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://cbseitms.rcil.gov.in/nvs/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the Navodaya Vidyalaya before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other  Notification Here –
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for NVS Class 11th Admission Online Form 2027-28 can read all the information related to the application form is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे ।

Documents to be Uploaded for NVS Class 11 Admission 2027

  • Recent Passport-Sized Photograph
  • Signature
  • 10th Mark Sheet & Certificate
  • 12th Mark Sheet & Certificate (if applicable)
  • Graduation Mark Sheet & Certificate (for PG courses)
  • Category Certificate (if applicable)
  • Domicile Certificate (if required)
  • ID Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, etc.)

NVS Class 11 Application Form 2027 : Mode of Selection

  • Selection will be based on Written Examination (Question Paper will be framed on the basis of Class 10th level including Mental Ability Test, Arithmetic Test & Language Test. For All Details Candidates must read official notification.

Important Question

Q. What is the application start date for NVS Class 11 Admission 2027-28?
Answer. The online application process starts on 02 September 2026.

Q. What is the last date to apply for NVS Class 11 Admission 2027-28?
Answer. The last date to submit the online application form is 30 September 2026 (Extended).

Q. What is the exam date for the Summer Bound JNVs?
Answer. The Summer Bound JNV Selection Test will be conducted on 10 April 2027.

Q. Who can apply for NVS Class 11 Admission 2027-28?
Answer. Students studying in Class 10 in a recognized school and fulfilling the prescribed age and eligibility criteria can apply.

Q. What is the mode of application?
Answer.  The application process is completely online.

Q. Is there any application fee?
Answer.  No. There is no application fee for NVS Class 11 Admission.

Q. How to Apply For NVS Class 6 Admission Online Form 2027-28?
Answer. Candidates can submit their applications through the official online form link provided on the official Sarkari Result™ website, SarkariResult.com.cm (Since 2009).

Q. What is NVS Official Website?
Answer. The Official Website of NVS is https://navodaya.gov.in
